name: Prepare RAG document datasets and review quality with Apify

parameters.content:
## Prepare documents for RAG
1. Create an Apify account and API token. Create an n8n Header Auth credential with name `Authorization` and value `Bearer YOUR_TOKEN`. Select the same credential in all five HTTP request nodes: Start Apify report, Wait for same run, Read completion status, Read QA, Read chunk operations.
2. Run the default fictional demo. Platform usage may apply.
3. To process your dataset, edit Choose input. Non-demo completed reports cost US$0.50 plus usage. The run has a US$0.75 maximum charge setting.
[Actor and documentation](https://apify.com/millgrah/rag-knowledge-base-sync-qa)

## Read-only report workflow
Starts one Actor run. The POST waits up to 60 seconds; an authenticated GET waits up to 60 additional seconds for that same run. No POST retry or unbounded polling. Queueing can exceed this window: inspect the exact run ID if the workflow stops.
Requires SUCCEEDED and a COMPLETE report before reading QA and chunks. Keep the last eligible full manifest. Review DELETE suggestions; this recipe does not apply them or update a vector database.
Full n8n runtime execution has not yet been verified; code-node fixture tests are separate.
